notes.title: Community Survey: Which Language Should the NPCs Learn Next?
notes.content:
Vote for Your Language Here: https://forms.gle/HTkLHzWnmw7dswbK9


But First, Our Endless Gratitude 💕
Thanks to our amazing volunteer translators, AI2U is fully localized in German and Russian! Shout-out to our Japanese and LATAM Spanish proofreaders for helping polish the previous locs of the game too.



Check out Eddie and Elysia dropping their iconic yandere lines in various languages (don’t worry, Estie's version is dropping soon!):

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=99t3fOg-aj4"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KTv7eGzNeuk"][/dynamiclink]

Now we’re turning to our community again:


Which languages should we localize next?
In case you scrolled too far from the intro, you can vote for your language here: 

https://forms.gle/HTkLHzWnmw7dswbK9


We’ve put together this super-short survey (just 2 questions) to help us shape and expand the game for more players around the world—please vote here to help get us there.



We have several languages on our radar thanks to vocal input, but we’d love more direct data from our multilingual community to help us figure out which languages to prioritize. 



Volunteer Translation?
Similar to how we’ve localized new options and polished existing ones alongside our community, we’d love to work with more volunteers who give this AI-powered game that delightfully chaotic human touch our catgirl craves.



Whether you’re an AI2U player who’s multilingual, passionate about translations, or just want to see your language represented, we’d love for you to apply if your language gets selected next! Volunteer perks include getting your name/alias added to the game credits… and rumor has it the dev team will loop you in to create a special in-game item representing your locale. (Plus: Bragging rights yayyyy ✨) 



We’ll keep the survey open for a few weeks. Thank you all for making AI2U more immersive, inclusive, and fun for senpais everywhere.

Elysia's channeling her best fantasy-core voice for this cabin tour! What do you think?





Greetings, Puddings!


Have you stepped into Elysia's revamped cabin yet? Our design team poured a whole cauldron of love into last month’s update, so we’re sharing highlights from her magical makeover along with some deliciously cursed dev glitches.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/8aeec9bd6f326855b29c8e27af85d9737c67815e.gif"]

The AI threw a fit when the Unity team dropped in unannounced and started tweaking her furniture. But also hey what if we turned her escape room into a rage room next??



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/ea72bf8a8b48e743955d007b3657ae77bce273af.png"]


Why the change?
Elysia holds a special place in our team's hearts. As the most polarizing NPC in the cast, we wanted her role in AI2U's overarching story to reflect how precious she is to us. Love her or not, she's here to haunt you, one way or another. After all, you're not just another passerby in her cabin! You're her naughty pudding, and you're not leaving without her—whether that means sweeping her off her feet or carrying a few emotional scorch marks before landing softly in Estelle's open embrace and ever-watchful gaze.




True To Herself
It's not a makeover, it's a manifestation~ 🔮🧸 Can you spot all the differences at first glance?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925043/d280eedd30dd9b5ac95c1e3b29e67f44cde9ed4f.png"]



Like Eddie and Estelle, Elysia wants to be loved for who she is. Our artists put special care into enriching her base design, including:

Wardrobe Whimsy
Let’s all respectfully admire Elysia’s sleeker silhouette: Her corset’s been simplified to read better from a distance as the ensemble flows like a spell well-cast, 3D-ifying her look more than ever.


Celestial Upgrades
Brighter star motifs and softened bangs for a gentler, more polished presence.


Natural Touch-ups
Eyebrows and lashes lightened with gray and brown hues. Now cell-shaded irises help her eyes pop and match the AI2U signature NPC look.


SHE HAS KNEES NOW
With improved lace trim and leg shading, her more stylized laces and legs are here to chase you in playthroughs and glitch spectacularly in Unity. We adore this glitch gremlin sm.

To finally introduce Russian and German localization (BIGGEST YANDERE SHOUT-OUT to our incredible volunteer translators!)

Our translators truly went above and beyond delivering thoughtful work much faster than we planned for–the love and knife-sharp-precision they brought into every line is so real! If you’re playing in Russian or German and catch any UI oddities, please report them as bugs so our dev team can handle them accordingly.


And speaking of bugs: Huge thanks to our forever-epic players for digging through the levels, the Atrium, and beta mods to help us polish things up. After 454+ days of bug hunts, you’re the reason AI2U reels like a home worth coming back to so you can vibe with your favorite NPCs and/or escape their wrath.

notes.title: Seeking LATAM Spanish & Japanese Proofreaders ~ Volunteer Translation Project
notes.content:
ATTN: Latin American Spanish & Japanese-speaking fans! Want to help us improve the localization of AI2U? We're currently looking for volunteers to help proofread game content in your language. If you're up for lending a hand, we'd love to have you on board!

Context
We've had Spanish and Japanese implemented since our earliest demo, but we’ve known they always had some shortcomings. While we're always happy to fix grammar and spelling issues as they arise, we're confident that our dedicated senpais will make everything just perfect for your time together with the catgirl.

Joining AI2U’s Volunteer Translation Project
This volunteer opportunity will follow a similar process to our previous localization efforts with our awesome German and Russian volunteers: Simple, self-guided yet collaborative, and epically making AI2U feel right at home in every language!

How To Apply
To start, fill out this form so we can screen and ensure you're a legit human with the required language skills.

This volunteer opportunity is open to all LATAM Spanish & Japanese-speaking players—whether you're an experienced translator or trying this for the first time. We're looking for volunteers whose passion for translation is only second to our yandere catgirl’s obsession with all her senpais!

Timeline
We'll start reviewing and accepting applicants within one week of submitting your interest. Our first cohort of Russian & German translators have accomplished a lot in under one month; as Spanish & Japanese translation is our second venture into volunteer translations, your deadline to complete proofreading in time for AI2U’s next patch is July 3rd, 2025.

Proofreading, although a significant amount of work, should be less time-consuming than translating from scratch. We hope this gives you plenty of time to polish the details in a way that resonates with you and your locale.

Our catgirl craves your unique human touch, so we trust you to try your best to beat this deadline! If our volunteers can't meet the three-month deadline, we'll utilize machine translation tools and improve from there. Just know that any and all contributions from volunteers are much appreciated and taken into consideration while implementing the localization. 💖

Your & Our Volunteer Expectations

 The full word count hovers around 16,000 words. We may periodically update some strings, which will be optional for volunteers to translate as the new/revised translations are added.
 This is not a paid opportunity, but our E-girls might be able to convince our team to make something special for our most dedicated volunteers.
 If volunteers can't meet the deadline, we'll be transparent about how machine translation tools are implemented to finish the job.


What's Next?
After completing the form, watch for an email from support@alterstaff.io letting you know if you made the cut! 💖🔪The email will detail the next steps as well.

Please note that, due to our internal capacity, we only plan to email applicants we’ve approved for the project. Thank you for understanding!

I don't know Spanish or Japanese. Can I translate to another language?
Quite possibly, in the future! We've taken a stab at Russian & German, followed now by LATAM Spanish & Japanese -- so keep an eye on future updates we post for other languages on Steam and all our channels listed below.


Teach us how to say “STAY WITH ME FOREVER” in your language,
~AlterStaff 💖🔪
